eyebrow: Why ordinary mistakes cost more here

steps.label: An idle GPU overnight
steps.sub: the same mistake as an idle VM, at 10-40x the hourly rate

steps.label: An oversized multi-GPU job
steps.sub: paying the full premium for capacity that sits unused

steps.label: A stuck or duplicated job
steps.sub: burns every GPU in it, every hour it runs unnoticed
